notes.subject: tok tok long
notes.rationale: נגע i minim 'ken kamap long, raunim han long' — 'touch' i stap long Tok Pisin olsem 'tok tok long' o 'raunim long'

notes.subject: נפש אדם
notes.rationale: nefesh i no 'soul' — em i 'breth/live-fors bilong man'; long hia em i minim wanpela man olgeta

notes.subject: sevenpela de
notes.rationale: prikaus bilong ritual doti i gat kaunting bilong De — sevenpela de

translation: Man i tok tok long bodi bilong man i dai pinis — long olgeta man — em i ken doti long sevenpela de.

tokens.gloss: bodi bilong man i dai pinis
